name: openpilot-claude-kit
description: Claude Code plugins for openpilot and its forks — cloud dev environments, device workflows, and codebase knowledge.

plugins.name: openpilot-dev
plugins.description: Knowledge for the commaai/openpilot codebase and contributing upstream — repo layout, code style, the tools, and what upstream will and won't merge.

plugins.name: openpilot-cloud-dev
plugins.description: Provision and work in an openpilot checkout inside an ephemeral cloud container — no local Linux box required.

plugins.name: openpilot-device
plugins.description: Read-only access to a comma device through the comma connect API — routes, logs, signed rlog URLs, and live cereal messages. No SSH required.

plugins.name: openpilot-device-ssh
plugins.description: SSH workflows for a comma device — deploy a fork branch, build on-device, verify headlessly, and hunt CAN signals. Knowledge and scripts only; no server, no shell tool.
